result.summary: On 2026-07-16 a three-subagent re-audit of `ff/` established that the FF "whole cell" was a cortex shell + passive MT + bead nucleus + IF cage + membrane in which the only active force was a lumped constant `f_myo`, the cytosol was a 0-D scalar ΔP from hull volume, and the Biot FSI channel was default-OFF in every landed native run (CYTOSKELETON_CYTOSOL_REAUDIT_2026-07-16.md; 1 of 10 actin architectures integrated). The PI first ratified "Option C" as an in-place FF evolution, then the SAME DAY superseded it: build a NEW engine, `ffn_sim/ac/`, on five pillars (fluid-first Biot substrate, active-from-the-root head-resolved NMII, ONE unified emergent actomyosin network, deformable-mesh compartments, integrated coupling on one physical clock) with the hard corollary that lumped counterparts are DELETED per increment rather than kept default-off. Over six days ac/ went from analytic oracles (cce76087) to a runnable native assembled cell at 494,802 actin nodes (d526b761) — but that cell never converged (`residual_start 2634 pN`, `inner_converged: false`), and the resting-baseline gate (`max|PF| < 0.21 pN`) became the single blocker for all dynamics for the next nine days. On 2026-07-22 a second founding decision landed: `ac/engine/` (13 components / 32 connectors, 6f91aec8 + `docs/v2_audit/cell_engine/`) became the canonical composition layer with three new hard rules — co-location in an array is NEVER a connection, each physical filament belongs to exactly ONE component (reversing the label-blind unified-network pillar P3 for the engine), and an 8-state evidence ladder where structural tests ≠ production — and its own adversarial audit simultaneously confirmed the engine was "architecture ahead of physics" (never run native, 173 mocked tests), which scoped the governance change down to direction-only. Growth since has been a disciplined chain of measured self-refutations: the cortex mesh was found structurally broken in 5 ways and fixed (fragments 11,430→1; interpenetrations 64,517→0; pre-step max|F| 2634→47.4); the 22c "operator doesn't deliver stiffness" root cause was REFUTED by an FD probe (operator exact to 1.0000, blocker is conditioning); GATE A was closed not by a solver but by reframing resting myosin tension as a DYNAMIC steady-state (clean turgor baseline converges 0.1398, ensemble 3 seeds); GATE B then showed cortical γ emerging 0→3.7 pN/µm from `k_on` binding events (seed-robust 85–90% bound, 3.66–3.82 pN/µm); and the fine-75 nm plateau turned out to be a construction artifact of the very `overlap_free` relaxation that had fixed the coarse cortex two days earlier (3.42→0.13 with the same solver). It ends with sf_arc KERNEL_BOUND, native ECM CUDA-verified, an SF motor whose MECHANISM passes natively while every MAGNITUDE is withdrawn as an unconverged transient, and the first composed native cell (495ac651) whose CUDA step was still un-run at commit time.

result.summary: v1 was not one model but five in 21 days, all inside ~/ActiveCellSim (still readable; it is this repo's `origin` remote and this repo's git history contains v1's commits). Gen-1 (2026-04-29/30, commits c159a18b→cb6ae3af) was a Taichi 1.7.4 MLS-MPM hybrid Eulerian-Lagrangian active-viscoelastic continuum of an MCF7 spheroid — 5,000 "cell-equivalent material points" carrying φ/ρ state on a background grid, organised as 6 additive layers (bulk active hydrodynamics, boundary-cell biology, adhesion-network φ-ODE, cellular Marangoni, mechano-osmotic, chemistry/ECM); 27 simulations reproduced the PI phenotype ordering (Bare 1.746 < Pre 2.359 < Lam4 2.657 pilot A/A₀), got the curvature operator to its first PASS (9.5% vs 2/R), closed 5 of 6 failing gates, and validated the Pajic-Lijakovic Marangoni retraction-direction sign — but its terminal production run (5k cells × 80 sim-hr) measured A/A₀_topdown peak **1.570 at 7.75 h decaying to 1.409 at 80 h** against PI experimental Lam4 **[8, 33.1]**, classified **Bucket P3 "mechanism-missing strict"**, with the earlier "2.643 plateau" exposed as a mislabeled substrate-contact-hull metric. Fixing the Layer-3 φ_memory contamination closed the retraction (end 1.677 ≈ peak 1.689) but moved the asymptote nowhere near [8,33]; the best full-stack pilot reached 6.22, and adding the very mechanism hypothesised to close the gap — Stage 1a++.b stochastic lamellipodial boundary events — *lowered* it to 4.78. On 2026-05-02 the continuum was frozen as a "reduced surrogate branch" (docs/v1/v1_continuum_backup.md) with the stated diagnosis of a "structural ceiling: spheroid-scale MPM can saturate without actually resolving the cellular events" — an assertion at that date, only rigorously demonstrated 4 weeks later, in ffn_cellsim, by the Layer-2 center-based line (r²=0.998 form, ~5–9× magnitude gap eliminated on six independent axes). Gen-2/3 then failed in three different ways in ten days: the image-constrained acs/v2 stalled with Layer-1 promotion blocked on three unanswered framing questions; the reduced active-wetting ODE acs/v3 (`dR/dt = ω − λ/R`) locked its form but could never integrate because its coefficients are not measurable (`xi_perim` BLOCKER, Vazquez 2022 "not possible to measure viscosity or friction directly", literature_params 10/10 value=None); and the mesh single-cell acs/v4 needed 20 calibration rounds plus 9 ad-hoc "form fixes" (30× drag, 20× ECM traction multiplier, displacement and z-extent caps) to reach speeds still 1.4–2× above its own literature bands, then hit a genuine form-level structural trade-off (uniform-weighted Laplacian cortex kills motility: 95× speed drop) and was archived on 2026-05-18 with an empty commit message and its designed fix (469-line Wardetzky bending derivation) landed in the same commit, never executed. The line that PI actually kept — acs_kb, a KU-anchored numpy ABM — was terminated at the moment of its nominal success: on 2026-05-19 it passed its Phase-1 end gate 8/8 KU validations / 56/56 tests (9d40c09) and on that same day the Phase 0.1 codebase audit's second PI pass declared it structurally wrong ("v1 = paper-models-as-mechanism, v2 = paper-models-as-validation-oracle"), archiving 45% of it. The founding principle was ratified that day (PHASE_0_3_DECISIONS.md:3-4, verbatim Korean: "처음 프레임워크에 추상화나 다른 과정이 들어가면 안됨"), and on 2026-05-20 commit 3f94ddcd cut the new repo: 476 files, +574 / **−110,060 lines**, with only ~5,500 LOC surviving as `ffn_sim/validation/oracles/`.

result.summary: ff/ was scaffolded 2026-06-29 (5c8b73b4, 587af846) as "Stage-6" of the two-layer restructure that archived the 8 HOOMD packages the same day (be7ce5a7). Its thesis, written before any kernel (ffn_sim/ff/ENGINE.md §1), was that a crosslinked filament network is a beam/truss FEM system and that kT enters cortical tension through the mean (regime A) or an ATP-rate kinetic layer (regime B), never a per-step thermostat — so Cytosim NF2007 physics solved as implicit mechanical equilibrium in Warp could replace BAOAB-MD without lumping any force law. Its decisive experiment was posed in advance: does an MD-free solve reproduce the BAOAB-MD γ-floor? It did (FF_STAGE6D, 2026-06-29, ~370× under band), and over the next three weeks ff/ grew, in order, inextensibility + units, cortex, Hand-KMC, GPU-native kernels (bit-parity 2.2e-16–4.5e-14, FF_STAGE6R), a unified weave() actin builder, virtual AFM with nucleus + membrane, a Mikado ECM and a 6-material ECM library (6/6 in band), FA clutch/substrate, protrusion, and a GPU-resident implicit solver. It also produced the project's most instructive corrections: a soft AFM plate through which 15–75% of cortex nodes floated (F was a ~10³× artifact, d4469b1b), and a three-cause dismantling of "the cell is too stiff" (Hertz-protocol category error 857×→16.5×, under-relaxation/press-speed transient E∝v_press with a relaxed equilibrium of ~17 Pa, and per-node drag ~100× over-stiff until calibrated to bulk η=65.9) — after which the only genuine elastic gap was the γ-floor, in the opposite direction. Two walls it never cleared: the native crawl (coarse 28–45 nm/s vs native 0.12 nm/s from grid drag Σγ∝Nc, then root-caused 2026-07-14 as no locomotory force dipole at all), and the γ-floor magnitude (~530× native, declared a force-magnitude/engaged-motor-density limit and handed to a wet-lab commission). A measured solver verdict (2026-07-14) capped algorithmic optimisation at ~9%, bandwidth-bound. ff/ did not end by failing its own gates: on 2026-07-16 02:24 a ground-up part-by-part re-validation passed 19/21 native (fd4babd1, including the pre-stressed P6.1 baseline, sphericity 0.99999), and twelve hours later the same day the PI ratified that the FF whole-cell composition was architecturally wrong — 1 of 10 actin structures integrated, the only active force a lumped constant f_myo, interior mechanically decoupled, actin/MT block-diagonal, FSI default-off in every landed native run (CYTOSKELETON_CYTOSOL_REAUDIT_2026-07-16.md:34) — and ordered a new engine that reuses FF's kernels as components (NEW_ENGINE_BUILD_PLAN_2026-07-16.md:3). Since then ff/ has been edited only in service of ac/ (cortex overlap-free builder 2026-07-22/23, collagen concentration gate 51a4e17d, crosslink density fix bc5ff3b0, radial_span 3a1f8866 on 2026-07-25) and is described in STRUCTURE.md as "재사용할 Filament-FEM Warp component와 frozen arithmetic reference".

result.summary: Across three months and four engine generations (Taichi MLS-MPM continuum → image-constrained "v2" → HOOMD fine-grained → Warp/CUDA `ac/` component-connector), the durable product of the pivots is not code but a rule set and a review habit. Almost every hard rule in CLAUDE.md is traceable to a dated incident: the Magic-Number Block and gate-semantics-immutability were both written on 2026-04-29 (`6f23aa4b`) in the same commit that reverted a caught scale-factor tuning (`csf_kappa_scale 0.25→0.05`, `Ca 0.01→0.001`); the physiological-baseline rule to the Π₀=0 γ-saturation (`1b465e3a`, 2026-06-04); the native-population rule to a coarse cortex that collapsed from filament count alone (`8cb1c76d`, 2026-07-09); "co-location ≠ connection" and "structural tests ≠ production" to a 22/22-PASS engine revalidation that a native diagnostic contradicted eight hours later (`1e913aad` 02:44 → `340e80be` 10:51, 2026-07-16). The governance mechanism evolved from a Codex-blocker/lock treadmill (2026-05-02..06: 205 commits, 84 of them docs, ~37 review-id fixes, essentially no physics) to a single lead with worktree subagents (`2218222e`, 2026-05-28) to a decision-card + PI-GAP-slot system that now names 32 unsourced parameters and declares 7 of 9 component magnitudes INVALID (`PI_GAP_EVIDENCE_CARDS_2026-07-25.md`) — the project's own admission of what it cannot yet claim. The self-correction record is unusually dense and mostly honest: 9 of 37 committed `REPORT.md` files carry retraction banners, and refutations are typically produced by the project's own adversarial audits. But the corrections repeatedly arrive *after* propagation — a forbidden basal-footprint A/A₀ metric headlined 5 DCM REPORTs (`69f0d91a`, 2026-06-19) and survived into the public README until 2026-07-06 (`463f3222`) — and the deepest failure, a 19,000–47,000× tuned body force ON in every committed spread run with regression gates locking in the confound (`05bb9799`, 2026-06-21), was found only by PI pushback. Costs were large but mostly clean: 110,060 lines deleted at the v1→v2 rename (`3f94ddcd`), 50,024 LOC of HOOMD parked read-only (`be7ce5a7`), 17,301 LOC of DCM idle since 2026-07-14; what survived every pivot is the oracle library (5,500 LOC, still never imported by `ac/` runtime), the KU-anchored parameter configs, and the rule set itself. The honest verdict: the rules function as detection scaffolding, not prevention — every one of them has been violated at least once *after* being written.
